title: Managerial Overextrapolation: Who and When
authors: Dayong Huang; Lijun Lei; Mengmeng Wang; Yuhang Xing
eligible_reason: The only DiD (Table 8 Panel B, TCJA 2017) has a single common adoption date: POST = 1 for annyr 2018 for all firms, sample restricted to annyr 2017-2018 (checked in sample03.dta: 677 obs in 2017 with POST=0, 654 in 2018 with POST=1). No staggered timing. The rest of the paper is panel regressions of guidance errors on ROA and interactions.
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe). Table 8B: reghdfe error POSTTREAT [MV MTB] if annyr==2017|annyr==2018, absorb(permno annyr) cluster(permno); TREAT = firms with tax-driven ROA shock. Tables 2-7, 9: guidance error on ROA, persistence and representativeness interactions with firm and year FE.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: TCJA: one adoption year (2018) for all treated firms.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common adoption date (2x2 DiD), not staggered
single common adoption date; time-varying controls

data_files_note: Analysis files built from WRDS (Compustat, CRSP, IBES Guidance, BoardEx, 13F, insiders) and FEC; shipped as final samples.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (Readme.docx, Tables.do, sample03.dta). Design fails the staggered-timing rule.
